currentParagraphText: “Did you use the favor he owed you from taking me with you to Nevermore?” Dina asked.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Did you use the favor he owed you from taking me with you to Nevermore?” Dina asked.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Feels a bit weird that you know your grandfather tried to bribe me into bringing you, and for the records, I would have said yes even if he hadn’t said he’d owe me one. Oh, and yes, I did try to cash in that favor, but he and Yggdrasil both rejected it,” Jake shook his head.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Actually, I did want to talk about that,” Jake said, making the others look a lot more attentive than before. “When I met with Yggdrasil and Nature’s Attendant inside the Primordial’s Divine Realm, I asked Nature’s Attendant to help me find a solution to hopefully heal the Fallen King.”
